notes: Lead came from product-docs blog post + demo signup. SMB, small engineering team (2 engs) focused on improving internal product docs search and public KB. Primary ask: low-latency search for user queries (avg qlen ~40 tokens), high precision on top-3 results. Interested in embeddings + light reranking rather than heavy LLM re-generation. Quote from call: "We need top-3 answers to be right 95% of the time; we can tolerate 100-200ms extra for a reranker, but bulk of latency must be in vector lookup." Using a hybrid approach: store vectors in FAISS (self-hosted) initially, may move to managed vector DB if ops cost gets high. Wants an example pipeline for hosted embeddings -> export to FAISS / Pinecone + server-side rerank with hosted generation. Cost sensitivity: tight budget, wants heuristics for batching and minimal token usage. Security: SSO + audit logs are must-haves for later stage; for now will use hosted API with shared team key. Open questions: vector dimensionality defaults, batching window recommended for their QPS (~8 qps burst), and whether Redwood hosted embeddings policy retains raw text. CRM shorthand: POC planned, 2-week sandbox, engineer Maya is primary contact, "Maya (eng) to validate retrieval quality".
requirements_summary: Workload: embeddings + reranking for document search; throughput target ~5-10 qps steady, spikes to 20 qps; latency target ~300-500ms end-to-end for query+rerank; cost sensitivity high; prefer hosted API to avoid infra ops; plan for FAISS initially then consider a managed vector DB. Need examples for exporting vectors and an SDK snippet for incremental upserts.
